nodes.title: Guides
nodes.summary: Product-specific checklists for account management and endpoint controls. Follow the steps for each tool, then review settings when vendors change defaults.

nodes.title: Account management guides
nodes.summary: High-value SaaS and community accounts need strong MFA, session hygiene, least privilege, and admin separation.

nodes.title: Hardware security keys
nodes.summary: Use FIDO2/WebAuthn keys on high-value accounts, register at least two keys, disable SMS fallback where possible, and test recovery before you need it.
